name: Cleveland State University
tuition_note: In-state (Ohio resident) full-time undergraduate tuition & fees for 2026-27 cohort = $13,658/year (per bursar undergraduate-tuition page $6,828/semester x2; confirmed by csuohio.edu/financial-aid/cost-attendance which lists $13,658 for 2026/27 cohort). Housing = room only $8,358/year for Fenn Tower traditional double (least-expensive/most standard) from csuohio.edu/residence-life/2026-2027-cohort-rates; room rates range $8,358-$16,000 depending on hall/room type. Room rate excludes meal plan (board).
